summary: Conditional flag-clear dispatch on the flag DWORD at this+0x20. Reads the flag word, and depending on bit 8 selects between two teardown-style helpers (Return0Stub at 0047ABB0 when bit 8 set, ResourceTeardownWithStateArrayReset at 00558990 otherwise); both paths first require bit 0x400 to be set or the function returns 0. Any nonzero helper result returns -1. On success clears bit 0x400 from this+0x20 and returns 0. Structural twin of FlagCheckWithConditionalPathDispatch (005575f0).

local_names.v2: the flag DWORD read from this+0x20
local_names.v3: return value of the selected dispatch helper

operations.description: v2 = this[8], reading the flag DWORD at this+0x20
Branch on bit 8 of v2: if (v2 & 8) != 0 select Return0Stub, else select ResourceTeardownWithStateArrayReset
In both branches, if (v2 & 0x400) == 0 return 0 immediately without running the selected helper
v3 = Return0Stub() invoked when bit 8 of the flag is set
v3 = ResourceTeardownWithStateArrayReset(this) invoked when bit 8 of the flag is clear
If v3 is nonzero, return -1 (failure propagation)
this[8] &= ~0x400, clearing bit 0x400 of the flag DWORD at this+0x20
Return 0 on the success path after clearing the flag bit
Invoked by AudioNetworkStreamCleanup (00544AF0) and by sub_5574B0 (005574B0)
